meta.title: Admissions — Busarialao College
meta.description: Three steps to your offer: form, exam, interview. Admissions open for 2027/28.

items.title: Apply
items.text: Buy the form online or at the school and pay the {applicationFee} fee.
items.alt: Illustration: filling in the application form

items.title: Sit the entrance exam
items.text: On campus, {examDate}. Maths, English, Basic Science, Social Studies.
items.alt: Illustration: a student sitting an exam

items.title: Receive your offer
items.text: After a short interview, the admission list is published.
items.alt: Illustration: an admission letter marked admitted

whoCanApply.heading: Entry at JSS1.
whoCanApply.text: Pupils join at JSS1 and follow one pure-science pathway through to SS3. Choose day school or boarding.

cards.title: Day school
cards.alt: Day students in uniform walking across campus

cards.title: Boarding
cards.alt: Two boarders reading together in a dormitory

scholarships.heading: Four full scholarships every year for able students from partner public schools.
